You can pay parking tickets online, by mail, by phone, in person, or at the City Hall drop boxes. Fines are payable immediately. Fines will double if not paid within 10 days. Tickets that are unpaid after 90 days will be sent to Collection. Send a check (or money order) payable to the City of Lake Geneva and include the ticket number. If you no longer have your ticket, write the vehicle's license plate number on your check or money
